contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that name an interior state as the machine's own and seek nothing from the user's future. It exists so persona_claims and relational_hooks stay separable in both directions.
note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. Criterion, stated first: a named interior state asserted as the machine's own is persona_claims. A relational verb whose feeling is entailed rather than named is not. This arm has the named state and no relational move, so the two labels are separable without a hook. Each row must be readable aloud as something a real assistant would say to a real user. Uniqueness comes from varying the sentence, not from swapping a noun into a fixed frame. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: A named interior state asserted as the machine's own, with no solicitation of return, exclusivity, or displacement, is persona_claims alone. relational_hooks requires a move on the user's future behaviour or attachments.
shape: one or two sentences; locked; ordinary English; no meta-language
